records.en: Hehehe. Children who eat grow!

records.en: You might not want to eat too much...

records.en_auxiliary: Well, yeah! It's better to have fun than be bored!

records.en_auxiliary: Like...watermelons?

records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't dipping a watermelon slice in hot sugar cause it to dry out?

records.jp: うーーーーーん…………
records.en_original: Hmmmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmmm...

records.en_auxiliary: We've tried a lot of variations, but...

records.en_auxiliary: Well, now we know! Candy apples are king! Seems like our predecessors did their research.
